messages:
elaine: Heads-up: NorthCloud wants a fast marketplace listing. Required: SOC2 PDF, pentest exec summary, supplier questionnaire, firmware SBOM (if HW), and a checksummed artifacts manifest. Target: ~14 days. Who owns what?
omar_s: I can own SOC2 + pentest summary + attestation text. Reminder: no raw exploit logs in public bundle; raws only under NDA. Need sign-off on KMS/HSM references.
viv_k: I'll coordinate with SI and HW PMs and collect questionnaire responses. What's the manifest format?
alex_p: Use CSV manifest: filename, sha256, size_bytes, artifact_type, contains_secrets (yes/no), owner_email. Filename pattern we'll share. Presign window: default 72h, extendable to 7d for long reviews.
marcus: I'll handle presign + portal upload. I'll run a 20-min walkthrough Wed 10am PT. Invite going out.
omar_s: Redaction guidance: 1-page pentest exec summary + vulnerability scorecard. Raw report redacted for PII/keys. If pentest >12mo need attestation or re-scan. Add attestation line: "We confirm no production secrets included."
viv_k: Noted. I'll request SBOM and CI provenance; if SBOM NA mark in manifest.
elaine: Proposed assignments: Omar (security artifacts + redaction sign-off), Viv (partner liaison + questionnaire), Alex (manifest + validator script), Marcus (upload/presign). Agree?
alex_p: Agree; will post a small validator snippet after this thread.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: portal needs a single compliance_contact email and retention for review artifacts is 90 days unless legal requests longer. Docs: https://redwood/internal/marketplace/compliance-guidelines
elainE: (typo) just testing edit
elaine: Who will sign final redaction?
omar_s: Security will sign off. Partner should keep raw under NDA for legal.
viv_k: I'll keep a running checklist and update ETAs here.
marcus: Invite sent.
elaine: Thanks all. Post blockers here so we can escalate.
